version.description: Working files, including staged/uncommitted changes. Base commit alone is not the tested version.
version.algorithm: SHA256 of UTF8 JSON.stringify(files), each file hashed as raw bytes; reports excluded to avoid recursion.

scenarios.expected: No optional storage or third-party requests, including late/scroll-loaded resources.
scenarios.observed: All current pages and late resource window stayed free of optional storage.

scenarios.expected: Only the essential choice cookie; no optional writes after interaction, reload or return.
scenarios.observed: Rejection persisted without functional cookie or automatic acceptance.

scenarios.expected: Essential and functional cookies only; preference is restored with its original authorization.
scenarios.observed: Only the single authorized optional service persisted; no other storage.

scenarios.expected: Saving personalization with functional unchecked grants no optional storage.
scenarios.observed: Essential-only selection respected. There is no subset of two optional categories to test.

scenarios.expected: Selecting functional enables only that category (the only optional category).
scenarios.observed: Functional category enabled; analytics/advertising categories do not exist.

scenarios.expected: Delete owned optional identifier and stop all future preference writes.
scenarios.observed: Preference removed and not recreated by subsequent motion or page navigation.

scenarios.expected: An old tab cannot recreate a preference after another tab revokes consent.
scenarios.observed: Previously failing stale-tab write is now blocked; dialog reflects shared refusal.

scenarios.expected: Expired authorization cannot be used by an already-open tab.
scenarios.observed: Expired payload fails closed and asks for a new choice, with no automatic acceptance.

scenarios.expected: Optional cookie TTL ends with consent; expiry removes authorization without interaction.
scenarios.observed: TTL and automatic expiry verified through page access and actual outgoing cookie headers. Raw browser inventory is retained, including expired entries returned by Firefox.

scenarios.expected: Withdrawal removes only owned optional identifiers, preserving unrelated/technical storage.
scenarios.observed: Synthetic non-personal sentinels survived. They are test fixtures, not actual site storage.

scenarios.expected: Contact responses are no-store and are not saved to Cache Storage.
scenarios.observed: Real local API rejects invalid synthetic input with no-store; no login/logout or authenticated private pages exist.

scenarios.expected: Choice survives closing and reopening a dedicated browser profile.
scenarios.observed: Actual dedicated chromium profile reopened; independent cookie and original choice preserved. No storageState used.

scenarios.expected: Choice survives closing and reopening a dedicated browser profile.
scenarios.observed: Actual dedicated chromium profile reopened; independent cookie and original choice preserved. No storageState used.

scenarios.expected: Consent and functional cookies use Secure and SameSite=Lax over HTTPS.
scenarios.observed: HTTP run. Run the same suite against real local HTTPS separately.

scenarios.expected: No unconfigured third parties, trackers or storage mechanisms activated across tested scenarios.
scenarios.observed: 2042 requests inventoried, including headers/cache provenance; no third-party request or non-cookie app storage API use.

limits: Development self-signed TLS: certificate errors ignored only in these dedicated local test contexts.
Only one optional category exists: functional.
No actual analytics/ad SDK, third-party iframe, login or private account area exists.
HTTP disk-cache provenance via CDP; not a complete disk cache inventory.
Playwright WebKit on Windows is not Apple Safari.
